player_prompt.intro:
O ntse o tlwaelana Mastermind.
O tlhoka go tsena ka kodi eo e leng {code_length} digits e telele, each digit go tswa go 1 go {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Ka karabo ya gago, o ka tsena ka thomo ya gago ka tsela e latelang: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Morago ga thomo ya gago, o tla amogela toko ka tsela ya peg(e) e nyele le e bosigo.
Peg(e) e nyele e bontsha digit(e) e tsielele ka tsielelo e tsielele, fa peg(e) e bosigo e bontsha digit(e) e tsielele ka tsielelo e sa tsielele.
O na le {max_turns} dinako go tsena ka kodi.
player_prompt.with_repeats: go ka nna ga boelediwa gape.
player_prompt.no_duplicates: e se na dikhopi tse pedi tsa yone.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ga o a araba ka lenaane la dinomoro tse di kgaogantsweng ke dikhutlo tsa sekwere.
invalid_move.not_integers: Diteng tsotlhe di tshwanetse go nna dipalo tse di feletseng.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Go fopholediwa gore e tshwanetse go nna le dinomoro tsa {code_length}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Dinomoro tsotlhe di tshwanetse go nna magareng ga 1 le {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Dinomoro tse di tshwanang ga di a letlelelwa.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: O setse o bonye {guess}. Tsweetswee leka go fopholetsa ka tsela e nngwe gape.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: You have cracked the code, solving {black_pegs} out of {code_length} pegs correctly
outcome.turn_limit: O fopholeditse sentle diperesente di le {percent} tsa dinomoro.
